structural_model: two complete MCT planes with explicit carrying and gantry ropes, 50 audited rank-one finite-gate replacements per width, and 21 four-port condensed gate-and-passage assemblies

passage_assembly.replacement_rule: At each of the 21 authoritative stations, remove the duplicated source property-3 gate TRUSS and assemble one transformed 12x12 four-port condensed gate-plus-passage matrix.

ordinary_gate_assembly.replacement_rule: Delete each remaining source property-3 TRUSS and assemble (EAeq/L) nn^T along its actual bottom-to-gantry chord; add no portal shear or mass.

aerodynamics.method: linear quasi-steady, no aerodynamic damping/admittance; each width's local moment is mapped by virtual work to its own carrying-rope/gantry-rope relative lateral rotation

rotation_convention.sign: positive rotation about global +X by the right-hand rule
rotation_convention.interpretation: local_roll_L/R are the moment-conjugate gate/catwalk section rotations; system_roll is a separate cross-width observation and is not Attachment 2-3 local torsion

structure_dynamics.response_solution: FFT periodic steady state; no startup transient

support_reaction_recovery.formula: R_c=K_cf*Phi*q-f_c; f_c=0 for this main-span wind application
support_reaction_recovery.physical_damping_cross_block: not defined; no C_cf term invented
support_reaction_recovery.static_result_scope: static-wind increment only, excluding dead-load baseline

limitations: The four-port stiffness is a static condensation of the finite gate-plus-passage model; local internal passage stresses require recovery from that detailed model and are not available from the twelve interface translations alone.

The ordinary-gate translation-only condensation retains one objective axial mode and five free-port mechanisms; finite portal shear requires retained rotational interfaces, so local-roll response is reported with a modal-convergence warning rather than hidden artificial shear.

The reported local_roll_L/R are carrying-rope versus gantry-rope portal rotations, while system_roll is the differential vertical movement of the two MCT planes; neither is silently equated with Attachment 2-3 local deck torsion.
Only displacement and low-frequency rope-force response are reported; retained modes do not support acceleration, comfort, fatigue, or local passage stress acceptance.
The stated 2380 kN breaking force is applied only to each physical carrying rope; no gantry-rope capacity ratio is reported because its breaking force is absent from Attachment 2-3.
Attachment omits structural damping, u-star, coherence constants, air density, random phases, and several force-mapping details; this is a stated-assumption recalculation, not an exact reproduction.
At six mapped sliding saddle nodes UX is free, so Attachment horizontal-X values cannot be represented as nodal support reactions; adjacent cable cut forces would be a different quantity.
